angle: The widely repeated cardiac-drift split (10-20% for untrained runners, under 5% for trained ones) does not survive contact with the literature. In the durability work indexed as PMC9977827, trained runners drifted 7.7% before a training block and 6.3% after it - both above the number the internet says a fit runner should hit. The deck is a correction: the number people quote is not in the research, and what the research actually reports is a smaller, less flattering difference.
figures: heart-rate drift 7.7% before an endurance training block and 6.3% after it, in trained participants (PMC9977827)
why: the original figure was blocked at verify precisely because it is unsourceable; the reason it is unsourceable is the story
